name: default
description: Error taxonomy used by the verify-paper pipeline's specialist verifiers.

categories.name: Equation / proof
categories.description: Mathematical errors: invalid derivations, wrong formulas, sign errors, broken proofs, violated domain constraints.

categories.name: Statistical reporting
categories.description: Impossible or inconsistent statistics: test statistics that don't match p-values, wrong degrees of freedom, percentages that don't add up, means/stds inconsistent with reported data.

categories.name: Data Inconsistency (text-text)
categories.description: Numbers or claims in one part of the text contradicting another part (e.g., abstract vs results, method vs experiments).

categories.name: Data Inconsistency (figure-text)
categories.description: Figures or tables contradicting what the text claims about them.

categories.name: Data Inconsistency (figure-figure)
categories.description: Two figures or tables contradicting each other.

categories.name: Experiment setup
categories.description: Flawed or misdescribed experimental design: wrong baselines, impossible hyperparameters, protocol details that contradict the stated methodology, data leakage.

categories.name: Methodology inconsistency
categories.description: The described method is internally inconsistent or cannot work as described (e.g., dimensions that don't match, steps that contradict the architecture).

categories.name: Citation / attribution
categories.description: Fabricated, misattributed, or misrepresented references: cited works that don't support the claim, wrong dataset statistics attributed to a source, invented prior results.

categories.name: Figure / table error
categories.description: Integrity issues within a figure or table: duplicated panels, wrong axis values, values inconsistent with captions.

categories.name: Claim / conclusion distortion
categories.description: Conclusions that overstate, contradict, or are unsupported by the reported evidence; rhetorical manipulation of findings.
